title: CloudEye job spec
description: What the operator chose in the New-workspace wizard, saved next to the uploaded video as <video_uuid>.job.json. Written by POST /api/videos/upload, read by the worker. See docs/JOB_SPEC.md for the prose and for how this meets pipeline-v1's status.json.

spec_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking change. A reader that does not recognise the value must refuse the job rather than guess at the fields.

video_id.description: The Video row this spec belongs to. Also the stem of the file it sits next to.

frames_fps.description: Keyframe sampling rate. 15 is the measured knee on the hero footage (HANDOFF section 4: 574 -> 1148 views buys +4.70 points, 1148 -> 2295 only +1.81).

mapping.description: Reconstruction backend. One value today; present so a second one is a schema change with a name, not an implicit default.

semantics.description: Who answers the scene-vocabulary call. Maps onto GET /api/models/catalog's "Scene vocabulary" stage: openrouter-glm -> id "openrouter", vertex-gemma -> id "vertex".

chat_llm.description: Who parses typed robot commands. Maps onto the catalog's "Command parsing" stage. NOTE: that stage is editable=false today and app/services/vlm_client.py has no Vertex path, so this is recorded for the worker and ignored by the running app - see docs/JOB_SPEC.md.

robots.description: Platform ids from app/robots.py (GET /api/robots) the workspace cares about. Empty means "every registered platform", which is what the viewer already shows.

created_at.description: When the wizard produced this spec. Local ISO-8601 with seconds, the same shape pipeline-v1's now() writes into status.json.
